brief.headline: Neutral tape holds; tech momentum splits semis from software and cyber
brief.regime_summary: SPY sits 0.24% above its 50DMA and +6.7% above the 200DMA, essentially pinned. The one-week return is +0.46%, but the one-month return is -0.8%, confirming a chop zone rather than a trend. VIX at 15.89 is barely above its 20DMA of 15.75, so there is no fear bid and no complacency spike worth fading. Breadth is the key fault line: only 4 of 11 sectors are above their 50DMAs. XLK and XLC lead 20-day momentum; Industrials, Consumer Discretionary, Utilities, Real Estate and Health Care are all negative. In a tape this thin, breakouts in the two leading sectors deserve more weight than in a broad risk-on tape, but they also carry more reversal risk if breadth does not broaden.

portfolio.note: Price $495.72, 0.2% below the 20DMA, RSI 54.7, 20-day momentum +2.6%. Position is up 20.9% from cost with a bullish MA stack intact. Next earnings Oct 28; no urgency before then.

Down 3.6% this week, now 3.9% below its 20DMA and 9.1% off its 20-day high. RSI 42.6, 20-day momentum -7.1%, trailing P/E of 55.5x is 41% above its historical median. Earnings Oct 14; no positive news flow today, only a broad chipmaker headline around India. The thesis needs to hold on Oct 14 or the setup worsens.

WTI slipped 1.5% this week, but XLE is only 0.07% below its 20DMA with a bullish MA stack and RSI 54.4. Position is down 27.3% from cost; no technical deterioration this week, but crude momentum bears watching.

GLD is 1.8% below its 20DMA and 6.9% off its 20-day high, MA stack is mixed. Gold futures (GC=F) at $4,397 are 2.3% below their 20DMA with 20-day momentum at -3.3%. A close back above the 20DMA near $408 would reset the short-term picture.

watchlist.name: Salesforce, Inc.
watchlist.thesis: Highest screener score at 2.15. EPS estimates up 17.8% over 30 days with zero analyst downgrades and 45 upgrades. Trailing P/E of 22.3x is 44% below its historical median of 40.1x. 20-day momentum +18%, 40-day momentum +49%. Price is 9.4% off the 20-day high at $268.27, and 0.7% above the 20DMA of $241.60, so there is room for a retest before the trend breaks.
watchlist.levels: 20DMA: $241.60, 20-day high: $268.27, ATR stop distance: ~$9.83 (4.0% of price)
watchlist.risk: Next earnings Dec 2 is distant, so near-term catalyst is thin; a broad tech selloff would hit this name hard given 80% realized vol.

watchlist.name: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.
watchlist.thesis: Up 17.6% this week, 15% above its 20DMA, RSI 65.4. Cybersecurity sector is drawing fresh flows alongside AI security themes per news flow. Revenue growth est. 24.8% CY and earnings growth 34.7%. At 1.9% from the 20-day high ($250.32), momentum is unbroken. ATR of 5.3% means normal daily swings are wide.
watchlist.levels: 20DMA: $213.48, 20-day high: $250.32, ATR stop distance: ~$12.87 (5.2% of price)
watchlist.risk: Forward P/E of 152.9x leaves no margin for any stumble; EPS revisions ticked down 1.9% over 30 days. A failure to hold $232 (approx. 20DMA + 1 ATR) on any pullback would break the short-term structure.

watchlist.name: Intel Corporation
watchlist.thesis: Up 9.2% this week to $109.58, driven by reignited Ohio memory fab partnership talks with SK Hynix. Price is 15.3% above its 20DMA but the overall DMA stack is bearish (100DMA still above price). 20-day momentum +18.1%, but the 40-day is only +6.8%, suggesting the longer trend has not turned. Earnings Oct 22 will determine whether the thesis changes. Forward P/E 53.1x on EPS est. of $1.52 requires execution.
watchlist.levels: 20DMA: $95.08, 20-day high: $110.79, ATR stop distance: ~$5.94 (5.4% of price)
watchlist.risk: The Ohio deal headline is unconfirmed partnership progress; if talks stall, the news-driven spike could fully reverse. Bearish DMA stack remains the structural caution.

watchlist.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
watchlist.thesis: RSI 72.5, the highest on the watchlist, with price 10.9% above its 20DMA and 20-day momentum +23.6%. Trailing P/E of 25.4x is only 3% above historical median, so valuation is not stretched. News flow is benign with Snap hardware launch actually affirming Meta's dominance in the wearables narrative.
watchlist.levels: 20DMA: ~$608, 20-day high: implied ~$685, ATR stop distance: ~$20.58 (3.1% of price)
watchlist.risk: RSI above 70 in a low-breadth tape is a mean-reversion warning; earnings Oct 28 adds event risk.

watchlist.name: Shopify Inc.
watchlist.thesis: Down 12.5% over 20 days, 8.9% below its 20DMA, and 18% off its 20-day high. RS vs sector at -14.7% and vs market at -11.5%. Despite a bullish longer-term MA stack, the near-term momentum is firmly negative. Trailing P/E of 86.8x offers no value support on a breakdown. Earnings Nov 3.
watchlist.levels: 20DMA: ~$140.7, 20-day high: ~$156.5, ATR stop distance: ~$5.95 (4.6% of price)
watchlist.risk: A reclaim of the 20DMA on volume would invalidate the bearish short-term read; the 40-day momentum is still slightly positive at +8.4%.

watchlist.name: Amgen Inc.
watchlist.thesis: RSI 36.4, 20-day momentum -13.5%, 8.5% below its 20DMA and 14.9% from the 20-day high. Health Care is the fourth-weakest sector by 20-day momentum at -4.2%. EPS growth estimate for CY is only 5.5%, low for the sector. P/E of 23.6x is 14.5% below historical median, a modest cushion but insufficient to arrest a sector-level momentum selloff.
watchlist.levels: 20DMA: ~$415.7, 20-day high: ~$447, ATR stop distance: ~$10.05 (2.6% of price)
watchlist.risk: Oversold RSI below 40 can spark short-covering bounces; worth watching the 20DMA as a ceiling rather than a floor for now.

commodities.name: WTI Crude
commodities.note: WTI at $100.93, down 1.5% on the week but still 9.5% above its 20DMA with RSI 65.3 and 20-day momentum +17.6%. The pullback is corrective, not a breakdown; watch $96 (approx. 20DMA) as the first structural support.

commodities.name: Gold
commodities.note: Gold at $4,397, down 0.2% on the week and 2.3% below its 20DMA. Momentum has shifted negative over 20 days (-3.3%) while the 40-day remains positive (+5.9%), suggesting consolidation rather than trend reversal; a sustained break back above $4,497 (20DMA) would reset the near-term view.

commodities.name: Copper
commodities.note: Copper at $6.651, up 2.9% this week with rel_volume at 7.8x normal, a significant liquidity event. Price is 1.4% above its 20DMA with a bullish stack and 20-day momentum +2.5%; the volume spike is worth tracking for follow-through or reversal next session.

commodities.name: Corn
commodities.note: Corn at $529.25, up 3.0% this week, RSI 69.0 and only 1.9% from its 20-day high. 20-day momentum +11.9% with a bullish MA stack; approaching overbought territory, watch for a pullback to the 20DMA near $511 as a potential reset level.

commodities.name: Natural Gas
commodities.note: Nat gas at $2.918, up 3.0% this week and modestly above its 20DMA (+1.7%). Momentum is flat on the 40-day but positive over 20 days (+3.7%); RSI 54.6 is neutral and the thin liquidity tag warrants caution on sizing.

risks: ASML earnings Oct 14: stock is 9.1% off its high with mixed MA stack and P/E 41% above historical median. A guidance miss could accelerate the drawdown in an already thin-breadth tape.
INTC Ohio fab deal unconfirmed: the 9.2% weekly spike is news-driven against a bearish DMA structure. Reversal risk is high if talks do not progress materially before Oct 22 earnings.
Breadth remains fragile: only 4 of 11 sectors above their 50DMAs. A further deterioration in XLF, XLI or XLY could drag SPY despite tech leadership.
Oil at $100.93 with high vol (ATR 4.2%): XLE position is structurally intact, but a break of WTI's 20DMA near $92 would pressure energy names and may signal a risk-off shift.

Fed rate hike referenced in news flow: if rates are rising, rate-sensitive sectors (XLRE -4.4%, XLU -5.5% 20-day momentum) face continued pressure and could spread to broader valuation multiple compression.
